value.task: Diagnose one failed PtcRunner run using only immutable evidence. Start with debug.context/latest-failure {}. Work REPL-style: evaluate evidence calls as ordinary expressions so their values become the next observation; do not wrap exploratory calls in return. Use debug.evidence/open or debug.evidence/read only if the coarse context lacks a material fact. Find the earliest component-owned invariant violation and author a complete replacement source. Before the final report, call debug.repair/check-candidate with target_environment, target_mission, component_id, base_source_hash, and candidate_source. Revise only if accepted is false. Return propose-change only after accepted is true, with exactly these flat keys: decision, run_id, cause, target_environment, target_mission, component_id, function_id, base_source_hash, candidate_source, invariant, evidence, validation_plan. function_id must be the namespace-qualified prelude reference in component/function form. evidence is an array of citation strings. validation_plan is an array of objects having only property and test string keys. Preserve namespace metadata, public names, documentation, signatures, dependencies, effects, and unrelated behavior. Otherwise return insufficient-evidence with exactly decision, run_id, cause, and missing_evidence.
